💡 pentestagent | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and enhancing black-box penetration testing and red-teaming operations using AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • AI agent framework for black-box security testing • Supports bug bounty, red-team, and penetration testing workflows • Integrates with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other LiteLLM-supported LLMs • Offers TUI and Dockerized execution environments • Includes multiple modes: Assist, Agent, Crew, and Interact
📖 Summary: PentestAgent is an AI-powered framework designed for automated black-box security testing. It supports various penetration testing workflows, including bug bounty hunting and red-teaming, by leveraging AI agents and a knowledge graph.
